description: 80-dps first-principles evaluation of 3D tetrahedral (alpha-simplex) nuclear coordination complexes (stacked 3-simplex 3-tree K_A, Pauli degree-1 bridge 3-tree, Pauli maximal degree-2 mixed-isospin triangle 3-tree, and hierarchical alpha-cluster complex C_A) with H_3/H_4 GPMT modified-dimension cumulants and CAL-3 Coulomb repulsion across 15 benchmark nuclei (2H to 238U). Zero free parameters, zero fitting, zero float64 intermediates.

model_boundary_disclosures.strong_simplicial_core: Derived purely from 4-state spin-isospin Pauli exclusion (pauli_clique_card_le_four, pauli_k4_balanced_isospin) and inductive 3-simplex face-gluing in AlphaSimplexCoordinationDerivation.lean; ZERO liquid-drop or Euclidean sphere-packing assumptions.
model_boundary_disclosures.coulomb_subtraction_scope: Additive electrostatic term E_C(Z, A) imported from computations/coulomb_energy.py (CAL-3 pion Compton length lambda_bar_pi = hbar*c/m_pi with derived alpha_EM(q_0) and uniform-sphere A^{1/3} radius scaling, documented as conditional in coulomb_energy.py:124-147). In mirror-pair differences (simplicial_mirror_split_pure_coulomb), the strong simplicial energy cancels identically.
model_boundary_disclosures.achiral_gg_interface_gate: b2_log_gg = E_0 * ln(1 / (z_D - h/2)) evaluates the Markov trace of the achiral crossing (T_i + T_i^{-1})/2 = T_i - (h/2)*1; promotion to the canonical charge-symmetric production bond is gated on conj:s5-so3-fiber-action (coulomb_energy.py:66-68). All three parameter-free bond channels (b2_log_D, b2_Bor_D, b2_log_gg) are reported side-by-side.
model_boundary_disclosures.pauli_excess_attachment_regimes: By pauli_k4_balanced_isospin, excess single-species nucleons D = |N - Z| cannot form s-wave K_4 tetrahedra (+0 tetrahedra). Both Pauli-legal excess attachment regimes formalized in AlphaSimplexCoordinationDerivation.lean are reported side-by-side: Regime A (pauliBridge, degree-1 peripheral bond: +D edges, 0 triangles, 0 tetrahedra) and Regime B (pauliTriangle, maximal degree-2 mixed-isospin (p,n,n) triangle: +2D edges, +D triangles, 0 tetrahedra).
